# Year-end donor letters, from your gift list, in a minute.

> Free year-end donation receipt generator for small nonprofits: paste a gift list, get one acknowledgment letter per donor with the IRS $250 and $75 quid pro quo wording, and a list of gifts that cannot be written up. Runs in your browser; donor data is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
